Doramus served as superintendent previously but moved to Parma School District in summer 2025, leaving the position vacant and prompting a search via the Idaho School Boards Association (ISBA). ## District Context
Champlain Islands Unified Union School District #66 is a component district of the Grand Isle Supervisory Union (GISU) in Vermont, serving areas including Grand Isle. LEAID=5000442 | Mount Ascutney School District #86, VERMONT | Step 1
============================================================
Based on my research, I have identified the superintendent for Mount Ascutney School District #86 for the 2025–2026 school year.

**Christine Bourne** is the superintendent of Windsor Southeast Supervisory Union, which oversees Mount Ascutney School District #86 [5]. Mount Ascutney is a component district within the supervisory union structure, and the superintendent at the supervisory union level serves as the top administrative leader for all component districts, including Mount Ascutney [20].

Bourne was initially hired as interim superintendent in 2022 and was made permanent superintendent effective July 1, 2023 [2]. She previously served as principal of Hartland Elementary School before taking on the interim superintendent role. She continues to serve in this capacity as of February 2026, as confirmed by the Vermont Department of Education's most recent snapshot data [5].

Catamount School (NCES LEAID 3700421) is a regular public lab school district in Cullowhee, NC, serving grades 6-8. It operates under Western Carolina University in partnership with Jackson County Public Schools.[2][3]

## Leadership Structure
As a small, single-school district and university lab school, Kim Winter, Dean of WCU’s College of Education and Allied Professions, serves as the listed LEA superintendent. Recent January 2026 news confirms her ongoing role, stating she is "superintendent for TCS" amid reports of academic growth.[13][4]

Sarah Tatham is the current principal, noted in multiple 2025-2026 sources including staff pages and NC DPI records.[5][7][1] An outdated staff page mentions Angela Lunsford, but current evidence prioritizes Tatham.[2]

A principal position was posted open starting May 2025, but no hiring news appears, and Tatham remains in place as of February 2026.[2]

## Context
Circle of Nations Wahpeton (NCES LEAID 5900095) is a Bureau of Indian Education (BIE) off-reservation boarding school in Wahpeton, ND, primarily serving grades 4–8. It is tribally affiliated with the Sisseton Wahpeton Oyate but operates as an independent BIE school without a higher tribal school system superintendent; the top leader is thus the school's superintendent or principal. [1][6]

## Leadership Evidence
Salary records list Trevor Gourneau as Superintendent of Schools in 2025. [8] Older records mention Sandi Gilbertson as CEO through August (year unspecified) and Leroy Chief as interim superintendent August–November (likely a prior year), with no recent updates indicating changes. [6] No 2025–2026 news confirms transitions, and the district website (circleofnations.org) could not be accessed for staff directories. [12]

## Tribal Oversight
The Sisseton Wahpeton Oyate tribal executives (e.g., Chairman J. Garret Renville) oversee broader tribal matters, not this BIE school's daily operations; school boards handle local governance without a named system-level superintendent. [13][14]

============================================================
Based on my research, Na' Neelzhiin Ji'Olta (NJO) is a Bureau of Indian Education (BIE) grant school located in Torreon, New Mexico, serving grades Pre-K through 8. [1][10] As a BIE school (not a traditional school district), it does not have a superintendent but rather a school principal. [13][19]

The historical BIE directory documents identify **Kenneth Toledo** as the Executive Director/Principal of Na' Neelzhiin Ji'Olta [13][19], but these sources are from 2008–2011 and may be outdated. The school's official website (naneelzhiin.org) does not display current staff information in the publicly accessible section I was able to retrieve.

However, it is important to note that the school mailing address references Cuba, NM, but the school is actually physically located in Torreon, on the northeastern edge of the Navajo Nation. [1][10] Given that this is a single BIE school (not a school district with a superintendent-level position), the top administrative leader would be the school's principal or director.

Without current, confirmed administrative staff listing from the 2025–2026 school year, I cannot definitively provide the current principal's name.
